image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ situated in a church or cathedral setting. The organ features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center and shorter ones flanking the sides. The instrument is housed in an elaborate golden/wooden case with decorative carvings and moldings. Below the main pipe array is a balcony structure with arched windows visible behind it. The surrounding architecture includes high vaulted ceilings with ribbed arches and stone columns.
